subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir sews tattoos on his body and believes that perhaps now he won't die. He is unconvinced of Thargus Ironhead’s honesty.
source_quote: Zalthir sews the tattoos on his body. He thinks that perhaps now he won’t die. Zalthir is unconvinced of Thargus Ironhead’s honesty.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz listened to Zalthir and scoffed, 'He’s lying and trying to survive.' Daz smiles and says, 'They all know that we are going into the Whorlstone tunnels, and they all hope the information we provide will help them. The question is, how do we get the information and profit most?'
source_quote: Daz, who listened to him, scoffs, “He’s lying and trying to survive.” Daz smiles, “They all know that we are going into the Whorlstone tunnels, and they all hope the information we provide will help them. The question is, how do we get the information and profit most?”

subject: Grinta Ironhead
fact: Grinta Ironhead is a female Duergar who approaches the group after they leave Clan Ironhead. She states that the Deepking has imposed exorbitant pricing on the Deep Gnomes, and proposes that if the Deepking were deposed, Clan Ironhead would be free to conduct discounted trade with the gnomes.
source_quote: “My name is Grinta Ironhead. I know you are trying to go to the overbrite through the city of the gnomes. The Deepking has raised prices to astronomical levels for the Deep Gnomes. Now, if the Deepking were unseated, Clan Ironhead would be free to do business with the gnomes, and we would be willing to do so at a discount of our normal prices.Greetings. My name is Grinta Ironhead. I am aware of your intent to traverse to the surface world via the gnomish city. Be advised that the Deepking has imposed exorbitant pricing upon the Deep Gnomes. It is my proposition that were the Deepking to be deposed, Clan Ironhead would be afforded the liberty to conduct trade with the gnomes, and we would willingly extend a discounted rate relative to our standard tariffs.”

subject: Thargus Ironhead
fact: Thargus Ironhead is the clan leader of Clan Ironhead. He explains that Clan Ironhead approves of the Deepking's policies and agrees that the Deepking's clan needs to be pre-eminent.
source_quote: Thargus Ironhead, who explains that Clan Ironhead approves of the Deepking's policies and agrees that the Deepking's clan needs to be pre-eminent.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum coughs and says, 'And free Thermbachaude.'

subject: Clan Ironhead
fact: Clan Ironhead is a Duergar clan that is initially unwilling to speak with the group but grants an audience after seeing their badges. They approve of the Deepking's policies and support the pre-eminence of the Deepking's clan. Grinta Ironhead suggests they would be willing to trade with gnomes at a discount if the Deepking were deposed.
source_quote: the entire group heads to Clan Ironhead and asks to speak with the clan leader. The clan is initially unwilling to talk to them. Still, their badges get them an audience with Thargus Ironhead, who explains that Clan Ironhead approves of the Deepking's policies and agrees that the Deepking's clan needs to be pre-eminent. ... Grinta Ironhead ... proposes that were the Deepking to be deposed, Clan Ironhead would be afforded the liberty to conduct trade with the gnomes, and we would willingly extend a discounted rate relative to our standard tariffs.

subject: Deepking
fact: The Deepking is a ruling authority whose policies are approved by Clan Ironhead. The Deepking has imposed exorbitant pricing on the Deep Gnomes, which hinders trade with gnomes. Grinta Ironhead implies the Deepking's rule is a barrier to economic freedom.
source_quote: The Deepking has raised prices to astronomical levels for the Deep Gnomes. ... The Deepking has imposed exorbitant pricing upon the Deep Gnomes. ... the Deepking's clan needs to be pre-eminent.

subject: arrival at Underlake Hold
fact: Jimjar, Spiderbait, Sarith, and Eldeth walk to the Underlake Hold, where Errde arms them.
source_quote: The following day, Jimjar, Spiderbait, Sarith, and Eldeth walk to the Underlake Hold, where Errde arms them.

subject: departure from Clan Ironhead
fact: The entire group heads to Clan Ironhead and asks to speak with the clan leader. After being granted an audience, they leave the stronghold, where Grinta Ironhead approaches them.
source_quote: the entire group heads to Clan Ironhead and asks to speak with the clan leader. ... As they leave the Clan stronghold, a female Duergar approaches them.

subject: assassins
fact: The group must deal with assassins before proceeding with their mission. The assassins are an immediate threat.
source_quote: We can do it after we deal with the assassins?

subject: Underlake Hold
fact: Underlake Hold is a location where Errde arms Jimjar, Spiderbait, Sarith, and Eldeth.
source_quote: The following day, Jimjar, Spiderbait, Sarith, and Eldeth walk to the Underlake Hold, where Errde arms them.

subject: Clan Ironhead
fact: Clan Ironhead is a stronghold where the group is granted an audience with Thargus Ironhead after presenting their badges. It is the seat of power for the Duergar clan.
source_quote: the entire group heads to Clan Ironhead and asks to speak with the clan leader. ... Thargus Ironhead, who explains that Clan Ironhead approves of the Deepking's policies...

subject: Whorlstone tunnels
fact: The Whorlstone tunnels are a destination or route the group is believed to be heading toward. Factions are aware of this intent and hope to benefit from the information the group carries.
source_quote: They all know that we are going into the Whorlstone tunnels, and they all hope the information we provide will help them.

subject: free Thermbachaude
fact: There is an unresolved objective to free Thermbachaude, mentioned by Grygum. The identity and location of Thermbachaude are unknown.

subject: profit from information
fact: The group must determine how to obtain information and profit most from it, as factions are aware of their route and intentions.
source_quote: The question is, how do we get the information and profit most?

source_quote: the Duergar Brannam shows up with the magical weapons and items Thorin and Zalthir requested.

subject: badges
fact: The group’s badges are sufficient to gain an audience with Thargus Ironhead despite Clan Ironhead’s initial reluctance.
source_quote: Still, their badges get them an audience with Thargus Ironhead...

subject: tattoos

source_quote: Zalthir sews the tattoos on his body. He thinks that perhaps now he won’t die.
